objective: One bounded rolling source budget; charge primary first and admit all secondary producers only from shared residual, preserving opaque relay service
confirmed_delivery_rules: Only newly observed explicit authenticated wire ACKs in Data space; never inferred handshake ACKs or duplicates
Scope bytes and freshness to connection and monotonically changing route epoch; reject previous-path acknowledgments
Confirmed bytes are transport progress, not a capacity grant; guard ACK compression, app-limited input, stale observations and mixed/transit ownership
No independent full allowance for video, screen and DATA; one node source ledger keeps debt and primary framing/fanout cost
fixture_policy: Reuse current original clocks, stimuli, shaper, file sizes and gates. No changed assertion to accept a candidate. Failed variants remain failed. No unrelated helper refactoring.
change_scope: Charge actual per-cell session codec fragments and ordered length prefixes once for each separately addressed owned work; do not change quota values or introduce a fixed source pacer.
